node.statement: For any simplicial complex K and manifold M, if f: |K| -> M is a C^r triangulation in the sense used by GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6, then GT-munkres-edt-def-8.1 supplies the relative-to-K simplexwise C^r vocabulary and GT-munkres-edt-def-8.3 explicitly makes such a triangulation a homeomorphism of |K| onto M.
